summary: Household of 2 adults in Georgia, no children, $45,200 earned income, employer health coverage. Income is above limits for SNAP, EITC (childless), and Medicaid (GA not expanded). No ACA credit since employer coverage is offered. No kids, so WIC, CHIP, CTC, TANF and school meals don't apply. SSI is unlikely given earnings.
